notes:
Version 2.1.0.0 updates the deck UI to match the web app.

The deck editor has Details and Cards tabs, a persistent Save button, admin owner
selection, a commander summary with partner support, and expandable artwork and
status controls. Add cards, import a list, or search within your deck from Cards.

Choose images or URLs for commander and card artwork, or remove custom art.
Uploads use the corrected server format and preserve your editing draft.

Decks show strategy icons, clearer rating badges, and tag status. Deck details
show mechanics, suggested/manual strategies and supporting cards below the
decklist, with a working Refresh tags action.
